title: A clinical trial of MK-1045 in people with B-cell cancer (MK-1045-006)
official: A Phase 2, Open-label, Multicenter Study to Determine the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of MK- 1045 in Participants with Hematologic Malignancies
summary:
Main objective: 1. Part 1 Cohort A (CLL/SLL): To determine the safety and tolerability of MK-1045 monotherapy 

2. Parts 1 and 2 Cohort A (CLL/SLL): To evaluate ORR with MK-1045 monotherapy per iwCLL criteria 2018 as assessed by BICR
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has histologically confirmed chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL)/small lymphocytic leukemia (SLL) active disease that is relapsed/refractory (r/r) to prior therapy.
2. Has confirmed CD19-positive disease.
3. If human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-positive, has well-controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy.
4. If hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive, has undetectable hepatitis B virus (HBV) viral load.
5. If has a history of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, has undetectable HCV viral load.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has a history of serious cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases.
2. Has a diagnosis of Richter Transformation.
3. Has a history or presence of central nervous system disease.
4. Is HIV-infected with a history of Kaposi’s sarcoma and/or Multicentric Castleman’s Disease.
5. Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency.
6. Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or required active treatment within the past 2 years.
7. Has active autoimmune disease (not related to underlying leukemia diagnosis) that required systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
8. Has any active acute graft versus host disease (GvHD) or active chronic GvHD requiring systemic treatment.
9. Has active infection requiring systemic therapy.
10. Has not adequately recovered from major surgery or has ongoing surgical complications.
